title: introduce-gpu-tiling-module-and-ephemeral-iam-with-subnet-claim-v2
author: Marina Koh
description: Add a GPU tiling Terraform module that provides tenant-scoped GPU subpools and a complementary ephemeral IAM profile for node bootstrap, and replace the existing subnet-claim controller wiring with a v2 interface. Motivation: current monolithic GPU pool modules made tenant isolation and incremental rollout brittle for large private deployments. This change splits nodepool topology into a tiling primitive (gpu_tiling) that composes AZ/instance-type tiles, introduces ephemeral IAM profiles to limit long-lived credentials attached to GPU nodes, and upgrades the subnet claim integration to an explicit v2 contract (claim lifecycle hooks, status field schema). The PR includes migration helpers and a rollback path. Migration notes: operators should run the included plan-generator to produce an ordered apply sequence per-tenant; ephemeral IAM requires a short-lived credential issuer (documented in deploy/ephemeral-iam/README) and a one-time KMS policy update. Rollout strategy: canary apply to a single tenant and AZ, validate scheduling and node bootstrap for 24h, then progressively apply remaining tiles. Rollback: revert to legacy module by running the reverse plan from migration helper; ephemeral roles are guarded by a feature flag. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-4719) - [x] module unit tests and terratest harness - [x] backwards-compatible variable defaults for legacy stacks - [x] migration helper script included - [x] e2e on k3s and GKE staging. Related tickets: Linear ENG-4719, ENG-4890. This description is a single continuous string per repo conventions.
commits: 3 commits: 1) add gpu_tiling module, tile schema, and docs; 2) introduce iam_ephemeral role module and bootstrap hooks; 3) wire subnet-claim v2 interface and migration helper script; git-signed by author
ci_summary: ci pipeline: fmt/lint/validate passed. terraform plan stage initially timed out for large tenant matrix, re-run with chunked matrix; terratest e2e initially failed due to missing KMS policy (fixed in second commit). Final run: all checks green.
review_comments: Arjun Patel (2026-02-12): Please split long variable lists into locals to improve plan readability; also add guard that prevents ephemeral role creation unless feature flag enabled.
Sofia Delgado (2026-02-14): Can we avoid changing the subnet claim status schema incompatible with older controllers? Suggest a transitional adapter.

Liam O'Connor (2026-02-16): terratest failure observed on GKE staging - node bootstrap started but kubelet failed due to missing iam metadata endpoint mimic. Added suggestion to mock metadata server for tests.
author_responses: Marina Koh (2026-02-13): Split variables into locals and added feature flag for ephemeral roles (variable: enable_ephemeral_iam = false by default).
Marina Koh (2026-02-15): Added a transitional adapter layer under modules/network/subnet_claim_adapter.tf that maps v1 status fields to v2 for older controllers; documented adapter behavior.
Marina Koh (2026-02-17): Updated terratest harness to include metadata mock; re-ran e2e and attached logs in CI.
Marina Koh (2026-02-19): Addressed plan-timeouts by adding plan-generator that shards tenant plans and documents operator ordering.
release_notes: Add gpu_tiling module for tenant-scoped GPU subpools, ephemeral IAM role module to reduce long-lived node credentials, and subnet-claim v2 adapter with migration helper. Operators must run migration/plan-generator prior to full rollout; see deploy/ephemeral-iam/README for KMS policy steps.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: mis-ordered applies can orphan subnet claims or cause temporary scheduling gaps. Mitigation: plan-generator produces ordered apply sequence; canary rollout and feature flag on ephemeral IAM; adapter keeps older controllers running during migration.
testing_notes: Included terratest suite (tests/terratest/gpu_tiling_test.go) exercising tile creation, node bootstrap with ephemeral role, and subnet claim handoff. Manual canary applied to staging tenant-az for 48h validating eviction and rollback behavior.
changelog_entry: Private installer: introduce gpu_tiling + iam_ephemeral modules, subnet-claim v2 adapter, migration helper; defaults preserve legacy behavior unless opt-in.
notes_for_ops: Run deploy/migration/plan-generator.py --tenants <list> to emit ordered apply plans. For ephemeral IAM enablement: update KMS key policy to allow the short-lived credential issuer principal and set variable enable_ephemeral_iam=true per-tenant. See deploy/ephemeral-iam/README.md for exact IAM snippets.
